description: Source code for a ByteReader class handling DWARF debugging information parsing, including reading initial lengths, encoded pointers, and managing endianness and address sizes.

classes.name: ByteReader
classes.description: A class for reading and interpreting DWARF byte streams, handling endianness, pointer encoding, and address sizes.

methods.name: SetOffsetSize
methods.description: Sets the size of offsets (4 or 8 bytes) and assigns the appropriate reading method.

methods.name: SetAddressSize
methods.description: Sets the size of addresses (4 or 8 bytes) and assigns the appropriate reading method.

methods.name: ReadInitialLength
methods.description: Reads the initial length field from a DWARF section, handling 32-bit and 64-bit length encodings.

methods.name: ValidEncoding
methods.description: Checks if a given pointer encoding is valid.

methods.name: UsableEncoding
methods.description: Determines if a pointer encoding can be used based on available bases.

methods.name: ReadEncodedPointer
methods.description: Reads a pointer value from a buffer according to a specified DWARF pointer encoding, handling various formats and relative bases.
